data.heading: Post-Construction Exterior Cleanup in Meridian, ID
data.subheading: New builds across South Meridian and North Meridian leave mortar, drywall dust, and overspray behind. We clear it off concrete, glass, and siding so your home shows ready.

data.body:
Meridian is one of the fastest-growing spots in the Treasure Valley, and you can see it in the new construction moving south of I-84 and filling in the master-planned neighborhoods up north. A finished home looks great from the curb, but up close there is almost always a layer of construction mess that framing crews and finishers leave behind.

That is where we come in. Monarch Pro Wash is owner-run, insured, and has been cleaning exteriors around Boise and Meridian for over 15 years. We handle the final cleanup that gets a brand-new home or building from "done" to genuinely show-ready, whether you are a homeowner taking possession or a builder handing keys over.

data.heading: Post-Construction Exterior Cleanup Built for Meridian Conditions
data.body:
South Meridian is the active construction frontier right now, with subdivisions like Century Farm, Movado, Sky Mesa, and Tuscany still filling in. New builds down here collect mortar splatter on foundations, thinset haze on patios, and fine drywall dust that settles into every corner. We work methodically around fresh concrete and landscaping so nothing gets damaged while the debris comes off.

Up in North Meridian, HOA neighborhoods like Paramount and Bellano Creek hold homes to an appearance standard from day one. That means overspray on windows, stucco dust on siding, and paint flecks on walkways all need to go before the community notices. We clean glass, wipe down siding, and rinse hardscapes so a new home blends right in with its neighbors.

Meridian sits in high-desert country, so wind carries jobsite dust everywhere and it bakes onto surfaces under strong UV. We adjust our approach to lift that baked-on grime without blasting fresh materials, using the right pressure and cleaning method for each surface on the home.
